WITH year_total AS (
    SELECT c_customer_id customer_id, c_first_name customer_first_name, c_last_name customer_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag customer_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country customer_birth_country, c_login customer_login, c_email_address customer_email_address, d_year dyear, sum(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount) year_total, 's' sale_type
    FROM date_dim 
    JOIN store_sales ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1998
    JOIN customer ON c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
    GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, d_year
), store_total AS (
    SELECT * FROM year_total WHERE sale_type = 's' AND year_total > 0
), web_total AS (
    SELECT * FROM year_total WHERE sale_type = 'w' AND year_total > 0
)
SELECT t_s_secyear.customer_id, t_s_secyear.customer_first_name, t_s_secyear.customer_last_name, t_s_secyear.customer_email_address 
FROM store_total t_s_firstyear 
JOIN store_total t_s_secyear ON t_s_secyear.customer_id = t_s_firstyear.customer_id AND t_s_secyear.dyear = 1998 + 1
JOIN web_total t_w_firstyear ON t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_firstyear.customer_id 
JOIN web_total t_w_secyear ON t_w_secyear.customer_id = t_w_firstyear.customer_id AND t_w_secyear.dyear = 1998 + 1
WHERE (t_s_secyear.year_total / t_s_firstyear.year_total) > (t_w_secyear.year_total / t_w_firstyear.year_total)
ORDER BY t_s_secyear.customer_id, t_s_secyear.customer_first_name, t_s_secyear.customer_last_name, t_s_secyear.customer_email_address 
LIMIT 100
